prompt_policy: Contact only when right hand/fingers/palm visibly touches or holds the object; near/ambiguous is false.

decisions.reason: Right hand is not touching the scanner/base; it is at a visible distance.
The person's right hand is reaching but clearly separated from the scanner/base with a visible gap.
The person's right hand is extended toward the object but remains visibly separated with a clear gap; no touching or grasping is shown.
Right hand is hovering near the scanner with a visible gap; no clear physical touch.
The person's right hand is hovering near the scanner but there is a visible gap and no clear touch.
The right hand is reaching toward the scanner but there is a visible gap and no clear touch.
The person's right hand is hovering near the scanner, but there is a visible gap and no clear physical touch.
The right hand visibly overlaps and appears to grasp/touch the top/side of the pink scanner with no clear gap.
Right hand is very close to the pink scanner but no clear visible touch or overlap; contact is ambiguous.
Right fingertips are close to the pink scanner but visible contact is not clear; appears hovering/ambiguous.
Right hand/fingers visibly overlap and rest against the top of the pink scanner with no clear gap.
